title: Local notes app with semantic search
scenario: Multiple viable architectures: several mature open-source options exist, so more than one meaningfully different option should be offered.
idea: I want a notes app that runs on my own laptop, stores notes as markdown files, and lets me search by meaning, not just keywords.

brief.problem: Keep personal notes as plain markdown files on one machine and find them by meaning as well as by keyword.
brief.users: One person, on their own laptop.

must_have.text: Notes are stored as plain markdown files the user can open in any editor
Search by meaning (semantic search) across all notes

constraints.deployment: Local desktop or local web app

assumptions.text: A single user; no accounts or sharing
assumptions.reason: The idea mentions only 'my own laptop'

unknowns: How many notes (hundreds or hundreds of thousands)
Whether a GPU is available for embeddings
